description: Declared mutants of the net Module, steps 1a, 1b and 2 (docs/architecture/target/v2/net-module-declaration.zh-Hant.md, D-2, D-3, D-4, D-6, D-8, D-10, D-12, D-13, C-MS1 and judgements G-1 to G-5; Design Invariants draft in docs/architecture/target/v2/net.zh-Hant.md; ids nt-). A mutant is killed only when the named test case fails with the expected message.

mutants.what: the ack bitfield covers 31 packets instead of 32: the oldest acknowledged packet is left out. Only it catches the width of the bitfield (G-2 still passes, since a later header acknowledges it)
mutants.find:
for (std::uint16_t i = 0; i < 32; ++i) {
            if (WasReceived(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(header.ack - 1 - i))) header.ackBits |= (1u << i);
mutants.replace:
for (std::uint16_t i = 0; i < 31; ++i) {
            if (WasReceived(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(header.ack - 1 - i))) header.ackBits |= (1u << i);
mutants.expect: the\ ack\ bitfield\ covers\ the\ 32\ packets\ before\ ack

mutants.what: an acknowledged packet does not acknowledge the reliable pieces it carried, so they are resent forever. Only it catches the packet-to-piece acknowledgement (G-2 still delivers, with duplicates dropped)
mutants.expect: an\ acknowledged\ piece\ is\ not\ sent\ again

mutants.what: the resend delay ignores the RTT and uses the floor only. Only it catches the 1.5 x RTT term (lightyear ReliableSettings::resend_delay)
mutants.expect: a\ piece\ is\ not\ resent\ before\ 1\.5\ x\ RTT

mutants.what: an Ordered Reliable piece received twice while its message waits behind a gap is counted twice, so the message is never handed out. Only it catches the receiver's piece de-duplication (a duplicate of a message already handed out is caught by the id check before it)
mutants.cases: connection: a reliable piece received twice*
mutants.expect: a\ reliable\ piece\ received\ twice\ is\ handed\ out\ once

mutants.what: an unreliable fragmented message is handed out after its first piece. Only it catches the completeness check of the unreliable reassembly
mutants.expect: an\ incomplete\ fragmented\ message\ is\ not\ handed\ out

mutants.what: a datagram of another connection is accepted. Only it catches the connection id comparison
mutants.cases: connection: a datagram of another connection*
mutants.expect: a\ datagram\ of\ another\ connection\ is\ dropped\ and\ counted

mutants.what: the pieces of an unreliable fragmented message that timed out are dropped without being counted. Only it catches a drop left out of the count (the reconciliation of G-2)
mutants.expect: unreliable\ pieces:\ sent\ \+\ in\ duplicates\ ==\ handed\ out\ \+\ dropped\ \+\ in\ losses

mutants.what: an AckOnly packet asks for an acknowledgement, so two idle ends trade AckOnly packets forever. Only it catches the AckOnly rule (lightyear packet_type.rs:27-37)
mutants.expect: an\ AckOnly\ packet\ does\ not\ ask\ for\ an\ acknowledgement

mutants.what: a packet id already received is processed again, so an unreliable message in a duplicated datagram is handed out twice. Only it catches the packet-level de-duplication
mutants.expect: Unreliable\ hands\ out\ no\ duplicate

mutants.what: the magic number changes. Only it catches the magic constant of the wire format (README rule 2: one per constant)
mutants.cases: header: the bytes are the documented*
mutants.expect: the\ header\ bytes\ are\ the\ documented\ layout

mutants.what: the protocol version changes without the documented layout changing. Only it catches the version constant (README rule 2: one per constant)
mutants.cases: header: the bytes are the documented*
mutants.expect: the\ header\ bytes\ are\ the\ documented\ layout

mutants.what: a packet kind outside the table is read as Data. Only it catches the closed kind table of the decoder (expect rewritten for step 1b: the handshake kinds 16 to 20 are in the table now)
mutants.cases: header: a datagram that is not a header*
mutants.expect: a\ kind\ outside\ the\ table\ is\ UnknownPacketKind

mutants.what: the handshake does not compare the net protocol version. Only it catches that item of the comparison
mutants.expect: a\ protocol\ version\ that\ differs\ is\ ProtocolMismatch

mutants.what: the handshake does not compare the protocol hash. Only it catches that item of the comparison
mutants.expect: a\ protocol\ hash\ that\ differs\ is\ ProtocolMismatch

mutants.what: the handshake does not compare the step length. Only it catches that item of the comparison
mutants.expect: a\ step\ length\ that\ differs\ is\ StepLengthMismatch

mutants.what: the handshake does not check that the allotter ranges are apart. Only it catches that item of the comparison (D-4)
mutants.expect: overlapping\ allotter\ ranges\ are\ IdRangeOverlap

mutants.what: two different fingerprints pass. Only it catches the comparison of the fingerprints' values
mutants.expect: a\ fingerprint\ that\ differs\ is\ FingerprintMismatch

mutants.what: a client without a fingerprint (K1) is compared on it and rejected by a server with one. Only it catches "K1 is not compared"
mutants.cases: handshake: a client without an authority strategy*
mutants.expect: a\ client\ without\ a\ fingerprint\ \(K1\)\ connects\ to\ a\ server\ with\ one

mutants.what: the server accepts a response whatever challenge it carries. Only it catches the check of the challenge
mutants.expect: a\ wrong\ challenge\ is\ ChallengeFailed

mutants.what: the server does not ask the product before it accepts. Only it catches Refused
mutants.expect: the\ product's\ refusal\ is\ Refused

mutants.what: the server answers a request smaller than its challenge. Only it catches the anti-amplification check
mutants.expect: a\ request\ smaller\ than\ a\ challenge\ gets\ no\ answer

mutants.what: a datagram of the connection does not refresh "last received" at the client. Only it catches the refresh by data (D-8: the data flow is the heartbeat)
mutants.find:
lastReceived_ = now;
        if (state_ == ClientState::Interrupted) state_ = ClientState::Connected;
mutants.expect: a\ datagram\ of\ the\ connection\ refreshes\ its\ last\ received\ time

mutants.what: the client sends a keepalive even when it has data to send. Only it catches "no keepalive while data flows"
mutants.find: if (out.empty() && state_ != ClientState::Disconnected && now - lastSent_ > settings_.keepaliveInterval) {
mutants.expect: a\ frame\ with\ data\ carries\ no\ keepalive

mutants.what: the client is interrupted at the first threshold, not past it. Only it catches the boundary of Interrupted
mutants.expect: at\ the\ first\ threshold\ the\ client\ is\ still\ connected

mutants.what: the client ends with Timeout at the second threshold, not past it. Only it catches the boundary of Timeout
mutants.expect: at\ the\ second\ threshold\ the\ client\ is\ still\ interrupted

mutants.what: the Peer component is registered in a World without a net role. Only it catches "a World without a role registers nothing"
mutants.expect: a\ World\ without\ a\ role\ has\ the\ same\ components\ as\ one\ without\ the\ net\ Module

mutants.what: the server keeps the Peer entity of a connection that ended. Only it catches the despawn
mutants.expect: the\ server's\ Peer\ entity\ is\ despawned\ when\ its\ connection\ ends

mutants.what: a value part is written before the structure update it needs is applied. Only it catches the wait for the structure tick
mutants.expect: G\-5\ \(1\):\ at\ each\ observed\ tick\ T\ the\ client\ equals\ the\ server

mutants.what: the ledger moves on when a value part is sent, not when the client confirms it (as if the send or the packet ack confirmed it), so a lost value is never sent again. Only it catches the application-level confirmation
mutants.replace: for (const Kernel::EntityId sent : partEntities[index]) ledger.entities[sent].confirmedStamp = now;
mutants.expect: G\-5\ \(2\):\ after\ the\ drain\ the\ client\ equals\ the\ server

mutants.what: a tick with no changed value sends no part. Only it catches C-RP4 (every tick, every Peer, a value message)
mutants.expect: every\ tick\ sends\ at\ least\ one\ value\ part

mutants.what: a confirmation does not move the ledger on, so every value is sent every tick. Only it catches the ledger's advance
mutants.expect: a\ confirmed\ value\ is\ not\ sent\ again

mutants.what: the client never notices a newer server World generation. Only it catches the generation comparison
mutants.expect: the\ client\ is\ told\ that\ the\ server's\ World\ was\ replaced

mutants.what: a structure update leaves out the wire ids of the removed components but keeps their count, so the client misreads the rest of it. Only it catches a field left out of the structure encoding
mutants.expect: G\-5\ \(1\):\ at\ each\ observed\ tick\ T\ the\ client\ equals\ the\ server

mutants.what: a value older than one already written for that entity and component overwrites it. Only it catches 'the newer wins' (D-4's key)
mutants.expect: G\-5\ \(1\):\ at\ each\ observed\ tick\ T\ the\ client\ equals\ the\ server

mutants.what: the server ignores a client's resync, so a replaced client World gets nothing. Only it catches the resync
mutants.expect: a\ replaced\ client\ World\ gets\ the\ server's\ World\ again

mutants.what: OnServer() is true at a client too, so the server's logic also runs there. Only it catches the condition of D-13
mutants.find: bool IsServer(Kernel::Res<NetWorldRole> role) { return role->role == NetRole::Server; }
mutants.expect: OnServer\(\)\ logic\ does\ not\ run\ at\ the\ client

mutants.what: a client with a rollback strategy (K3) is built and treated as K2. Only it catches the refusal until step 4
mutants.find: if (role->role == NetRole::Client && rollback != nullptr && rollback->strategy != nullptr) {
mutants.cases: replication: a client with a rollback strategy*
mutants.expect: a\ client\ with\ a\ rollback\ strategy\ is\ refused\ until\ step\ 4\ \(NT\-E5\)

mutants.what: a missing slot does not hold the last input (the default value is written). Only it catches hold-last
mutants.expect: G\-6:\ each\ server\ tick\ has\ the\ client's\ input\ of\ that\ tick,\ or\ the\ last\ one\ held

mutants.what: a held input keeps its one-shot fields, so a press fires again. Only it catches InputOptions::held (C-IN3)
mutants.expect: G\-6:\ a\ one\-shot\ input\ fires\ only\ at\ the\ tick\ it\ was\ given\ \(once\)

mutants.what: a slot beyond the server's tick + window is stored. Only it catches the window's upper edge
mutants.expect: G\-6:\ a\ slot\ beyond\ the\ window\ is\ dropped\ and\ counted

mutants.what: a slot at or before the tick already consumed is stored. Only it catches the window's lower edge
mutants.expect: G\-6:\ slots\ stored\ ==\ consumed\ \+\ still\ ahead

mutants.what: a slot that arrives again overwrites the kept one and counts as stored ((Peer, tick) not kept once), so more slots are stored than consumed. Only it catches the de-duplication of C-IN1
mutants.expect: G\-6:\ slots\ stored\ ==\ consumed\ \+\ still\ ahead

mutants.what: a held step is not counted as missing. Only it catches the missing count (D-12)
mutants.expect: G\-6:\ every\ held\ input\ is\ counted\ as\ missing

mutants.what: the entry is added with AddSystem even where the World has an authority strategy (it would run while resimulating). Only it catches authority.Ingress
mutants.cases: input: the entry has the same name*
mutants.expect: the\ entry\ is\ added\ through\ authority\.Ingress\ where\ the\ World\ has\ a\ strategy

mutants.what: a value sent again unchanged is written again, so Changed<T> is true without a change. Only it catches the comparison before the write (CCR-8)
mutants.cases: replication: a value sent again unchanged*
mutants.expect: a\ value\ sent\ again\ unchanged\ does\ not\ make\ Changed<T>\ true\ \(CCR\-8\)

mutants.what: a new handshake from the same endpoint gets the old connection back (the salt is not compared). Only it catches the salt
mutants.cases: handshake: a new handshake from the same endpoint*
mutants.expect: a\ reconnect\ from\ the\ same\ endpoint\ is\ a\ new\ connection

mutants.what: the clock sync never jumps (not even on connecting). Only it catches the snap
mutants.expect: the\ first\ sync\ after\ connecting\ jumps\ to\ the\ target

mutants.what: a client behind its target slows down instead of speeding up. Only it catches the direction of the speed
mutants.find: if (sync.consecutive >= sync.settings.consecutive) scale = behind ? sync.settings.speedup : 1.0 / sync.settings.speedup;
mutants.replace: if (sync.consecutive >= sync.settings.consecutive) scale = behind ? 1.0 / sync.settings.speedup : sync.settings.speedup;
mutants.expect: a\ client\ falling\ behind\ its\ target\ speeds\ up

mutants.what: back within the deadband the speed stays as it was. Only it catches the return to 1
mutants.expect: back\ near\ the\ target\ the\ speed\ is\ 1\ again

mutants.what: the clock sync is not added to the time Module's Tick writers, so a server-authority client is AU-E5. Only it catches the registration
mutants.cases: input: the entry has the same name*
mutants.expect: AU\-E5\ System\ 'SyncClock'

mutants.what: the remote estimate takes each packet as it is (no EMA). Only it catches the smoothing of the remote estimate
mutants.find: sync.offset = sync.haveOffset ? sync.offset + alpha * (raw - sync.offset) : raw;
mutants.expect: once\ settled\ the\ client\ stays\ within\ 2\ ticks\ of\ its\ sync\ target

mutants.what: A replicated Resource is sent every tick, confirmed or not. Only it catches the ledger's check of a Resource's confirmed stamp
mutants.expect: a\ confirmed\ Resource\ is\ not\ sent\ again

mutants.what: The default Resource apply writes the value even when it is the same. Only it catches CCR-8 for a replicated Resource
mutants.expect: Changed\(\)\ is\ true\ once\ per\ real\ change\ of\ the\ score

mutants.what: The protocol hash leaves the replicated Resources out. Only it catches the Resources' part of the hash
mutants.find: for (const auto& entry : resources) text += "r:" + entry->name + ":" + std::to_string(entry->version) + ";";
mutants.expect: the\ protocol\ hash\ includes\ the\ replicated\ Resources

mutants.what: The client does not call the apply given to ReplicateResource (the value is dropped as applied). Only it catches the registration's apply being the one called (the state machine's request kind reaches the client through it)
mutants.expect: TEST CASE:\s+statesync: the server's request reaches the client

mutants.what: A new client World takes the epoch of the first message it reads (the server's old one) instead of keeping its own. Only it catches B1's "the epoch is not taken from a message"
mutants.expect: B1:\ after\ a\ resync\ the\ server\ takes\ the\ client's\ confirmations\ again

mutants.what: Every client World after the first gets epoch 1, so the third World's resync is not told from the second's. Only it catches B1's "the epoch grows with every client World"
mutants.expect: B1:\ the\ messages\ of\ the\ client's\ old\ epoch\ are\ dropped\ and\ counted

mutants.what: The first message a client World reads is taken whatever its epoch (the generation branch returns before the epoch check). Only it catches the epoch check of a new World's first messages
mutants.expect: B1:\ the\ messages\ of\ the\ client's\ old\ epoch\ are\ dropped\ and\ counted

mutants.what: ReplicateOut empties the outbox in a frame whose tick it does not send, so those server messages are lost. Only it catches B2
mutants.expect: B2:\ every\ server\ message\ written\ goes\ out

mutants.what: A message needing a structure counts it as applied when none was applied yet (0 meant both "none" and "tick 0"). Only it catches S1
mutants.expect: S1:\ no\ value\ is\ written\ before\ the\ structure\ of\ tick\ 0

mutants.what: The ledger takes a structure update the connection refused. Only it catches S3
mutants.expect: S3:\ a\ refused\ structure\ update\ is\ sent\ again

mutants.what: A late response of an older handshake (smaller salt) ends the newer connection. Only it catches S2 (a)
mutants.expect: S2\ a:

mutants.what: A connecting client takes an accept of another handshake. Only it catches S2 (b)
mutants.expect: S2\ b:

mutants.what: What the server drops from a client's confirmations and resyncs is not counted on its Peer. Only it catches S4's server-side counts (the inputs' are counted apart)
mutants.find: void DropAt(PeerLedger& ledger, const ReplicaDrop reason) { ++ledger.drops[static_cast<std::size_t>(reason)]; }
mutants.expect: S4:\ unreadable\ messages\ and\ unknown\ kinds\ are\ counted

mutants.what: A structure update's component for an entity the client lacks is not counted. Only it catches S4's structure count
mutants.find:
if (outcome == ApplyOutcome::Malformed) Drop(state, ReplicaDrop::Malformed);
            if (outcome == ApplyOutcome::Missing) Drop(state, ReplicaDrop::MissingTarget);
mutants.expect: S4:\ a\ structure\ update's\ component\ for\ a\ missing\ entity\ is\ counted

mutants.what: The server takes a confirmation of another server World. Only it catches the confirmations' generation check
mutants.expect: small\ thing\ 2:\ confirmations\ and\ inputs\ of\ another\ generation

mutants.what: The server fills inputs of another server World into the Peer's buffer. Only it catches the inputs' generation check
mutants.expect: small\ thing\ 2:\ confirmations\ and\ inputs\ of\ another\ generation

mutants.what: With nothing consuming them, the slots the server's tick passed stay in the buffer. Only it catches small thing 1
mutants.expect: small\ thing\ 1:\ the\ server\ keeps\ no\ slot\ behind\ its\ tick

mutants.what: A lasting Link failure is tried again in the same frame. Only it catches small thing 3
mutants.expect: small\ thing\ 3:\ a\ lasting\ failure\ stops

mutants.what: A reliable window that is not a power of two is taken. Only it catches small thing 4's assertion
mutants.expect: expected\ GYO_ASSERT\ to\ fail:\ N::Connection\(settings\)

mutants.what: NT-7 link set: the net Module links one more target (the state machine). Only it reaches gyo_net's link set
mutants.find: target_link_libraries(gyo_net PUBLIC GYO::Base GYO::OS GYO::Time GYO::Kernel GYO::Orchestration)
mutants.replace: target_link_libraries(gyo_net PUBLIC GYO::Base GYO::OS GYO::Time GYO::Kernel GYO::Orchestration GYO::StateMachine)
mutants.expect: gyo_net links\s+GYO::Authority;GYO::Base;GYO::EntityIds;GYO::Kernel;GYO::OS;GYO::Orchestration;GYO::Rollback;GYO::StateMachine;GYO::Time;GYO::WorldTime;\s+expected exactly
